stem.text: The graph shows how the acceleration of an object moving in a straight line varies with time.

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled acceleration and horizontal axis labelled time. The curve starts at the origin, rises to a single peak and returns to zero.

stem.text: Which graph shows the variation with time of the velocity of the object over the same time interval?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled velocity and horizontal axis labelled time. The curve starts at the origin and rises, with a change in slope, and levels off at the end.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled velocity and horizontal axis labelled time. The curve starts at the origin, rises to a single peak and returns to zero.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled velocity and horizontal axis labelled time. A sinusoidal curve starts at the origin, has a positive peak, crosses the time axis and has a negative trough.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled velocity and horizontal axis labelled time. The curve starts at the origin and rises with increasing steepness.
